channel.title: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
channel.description:
Dan and Patrick's daily antidote to doomscrolling: the most consequential developments in science and tech with sources and honest disagreement, a daily mindset principle for good mental health (Think Positive — the first show to take mental health as seriously as the science), and one concrete action with real numbers — The Lever. Plus the Do Positive Dispatch: what listeners actually did. Do something about it.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 1: Two friends built a fourteen-show daily podcast network with an AI pipeline and no studio or staff.
item.description: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast Two friends built a fourteen-show daily podcast network with an AI pipeline and no studio or staff. The most consequential media story today is not a headline about a new platform or a funding round. It is the fact that two people can now run what once required an entire company. Most feeds profit when audiences feel powerless; this club begins from the opposite premise that individuals are not powerless. ...
